---
title: "Input datasets for OceanBench challenger evaluation"
---

OceanBench exposes the [input datasets](/documentation/api/datasets/input/index.qmd#oceanbench.datasets.input) needed by challengers through the `oceanbench.datasets.input` Python API.

## Available Datasets

`oceanbench.datasets.input.glo12_nowcasts()`

:   Weekly GLO12 nowcasts from January 4, 2023 to December 31, 2025.

    see more at: [ifs_nowcasts()](/documentation/api/datasets/input/index.qmd#oceanbench.datasets.input.ifs_nowcasts).

`oceanbench.datasets.input.ifs_forcings()`

:   Weekly IFS forcings from January 3, 2023 to December 30, 2025.

    see more at: [ifs_nowcasts()](/documentation/api/datasets/input/index.qmd#oceanbench.datasets.input.ifs_nowcasts).

`oceanbench.datasets.input.ifs_nowcasts()`

:   Weekly IFS atmospheric nowcasts for Tuesdays from January 2 to December 24, 2024, with 00, 06, 12 and 18 UTC data in each store.

    see more at: [ifs_nowcasts()](/documentation/api/datasets/input/index.qmd#oceanbench.datasets.input.ifs_nowcasts).

The units and time conventions of all three datasets are described in [units and time conventions of the input data](/documentation/input-data-conventions/index.qmd).
